meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (unitary national system with separate administrative courts)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-Germany Double Taxation Agreement (as amended by subsequent protocols)
France-United States Income and Capital Taxation Treaty (as amended)
France-China Double Taxation Agreement (signed 1984, as amended)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier, articles L.561-1 to L.561-57 and R.561-1 to R.561-59; Code de commerce, article L.123-1 and article R.123-166 et seq.; Décret n° 2016-1467 du 28 octobre 2016 on beneficial-owner declarations and prior administrative controls; Ordonnance n° 2020-115 du 12 février 2020 reinforcing the French AML/CFT framework; EU Directive (EU) 2015/849 and Directive (EU) 2018/843 as transposed into French law; FATF Recommendations 10, 12, 24 and 25.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national identity card of each proposed manager and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent passport/civil registry authority of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization (depending on the origin country's accession to the Hague Convention of 5 October 1961)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing and incumbency (or equivalent official extract) for any corporate shareholder or parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization (depending on the jurisdiction)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of no criminal record (extrait de casier judiciaire or police clearance certificate) for each appointed manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent judicial or police authority of the manager's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization (depending on the origin country)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement issued within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization (may be waived if a notarized copy and sworn French translation are accepted by the receiving authority)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly notarized power of attorney appointing the French formation agent or representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the grantor's country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, managers, shareholders and authorised signatories against the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, the UN Security Council consolidated list, OFAC's SDN list where USD clearing or correspondent banking is used, and French domestic asset-freezing measures administered by the Direction générale du Trésor and TRACFIN. PEP status is determined under article L.561-10 of the Code monétaire et financier; enhanced due diligence is required for PEPs, their family members and close associates, including verification of source of wealth and funds. Screening results must be documented and retained for five years; any positive hit requires immediate refusal of the application or a suspicious activity report to TRACFIN.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), operated by INPI as the single national registry portal; public extracts are available via data.inpi.fr and Infogreffe for RCS extracts.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate instruments and the company name must be in the French language. The registered name must use Latin or Roman characters; if a foreign-language or non-Latin-script name is used, a French transliteration and sworn French translation must be submitted. The name must be preceded or followed immediately by the words 'Société à responsabilité limitée' or the abbreviation 'SARL' and the amount of share capital on all corporate documents. The name must be distinctive, non-misleading, and compatible with public order and third-party rights.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not operate a standalone name-reservation register; the name is checked at the time of filing through the Guichet Unique and becomes protected only upon registration. A rejected name is refused with a reasoned decision from the INPI/registrar. The applicant may correct and resubmit the dossier immediately with a different distinctive sign. Where the rejection is based on identity or confusing similarity with an existing right, the applicant may file a written administrative reconsideration with INPI within 30 days, produce written consent or renunciation from the prior right-holder, or appeal to the competent tribunal judiciaire or tribunal de commerce within two months of the reasoned refusal. A final judicial appeal lies to the competent Court of Appeal. For the purpose of pre-registration due diligence, a name availability report is treated as valid for 30 calendar days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A commercial domiciliation service or virtual office is legally permitted for a French SARL's registered office, subject to a written domiciliation agreement and annual declaration. However, for an industrial exporter of high-speed aseptic liquid packaging automated lines under ISIC 2825, a purely virtual office without any operational or managerial substance is not advisable. The company must maintain a real place of management in France; tax, customs and UBO verification authorities may disregard the registered seat if no physical activity can be demonstrated. A domiciliation contract may be used for up to five years but does not replace the need for production, quality-control or logistics premises attributable to the company's packaging automation export business.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to moderate: approximately 15% probability of an unannounced inspection in the first year for a SARL using a virtual registered office with no physical assets. If the company claims VAT refunds, customs relief, or treaty benefits while maintaining no operational plant, the quantified annual likelihood increases to approximately 40%. Inspections may be conducted by the administration fiscale under the Code général des impôts procedure and by customs authorities under the Code des douanes.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT and UBO piercing due-diligence review (corporate chain, ownership records, negative news and sanctions database checks for all UBOs and proposed managers)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing Paris market benchmark at EUR 300-450 per hour; estimated 4-6 hours

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and trademark conflict search in INPI/RNE and EUIPO databases
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French law firm or trademark attorney; official INPI database search is free
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Professional legal fee for availability report and conflict analysis; market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN and French sanctions screening per individual for four persons
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-screen market rate of USD 50-150 plus verification time; total for four individuals

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of three notarized foreign documents (power of attorney, good-standing certificate, identity copy)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs or consulate of the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory consular tariff and apostille certificate fee; estimated USD 60-120 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn French translation of legalized foreign documents (approximately 20 pages)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator approved by the French courts (traducteur agréé)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-word public rate of approximately EUR 0.15-0.25 with minimum per document; 3-5 documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preparation of the French beneficial-owner declaration and RNE pre-filing compliance check
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French law firm; RNE portal filing itself is free
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed professional fee for UBO declaration drafting and verification against article L.561-45 of the Code monétaire et financier

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Optional notarial authentication of draft articles of association (recommended for foreign shareholders)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff (tarif notarié) plus disbursements; market benchmark USD 1,200-1,800

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Title III, Articles L.223-1 to L.223-56 (SARL); implementing Decree No. 67-236 and RCS procedural rules under Code de commerce Article R.123-1 et seq.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce of the registered office (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés), now accessed through the INPI single electronic window (Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de création d'une société commerciale (form M0 / CERFA 12576), accompanied by the signed statutory articles (statuts), filed via the Guichet unique.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for a French SARL. The articles freely fix the capital amount. Cash contributions must be paid up to at least one-fifth at subscription, with the balance paid according to the articles. All formation capital must be deposited in a blocked escrow account with a licensed French bank or notary, and released to the company only after RCS registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF FOUNDING MEMBERS OF FR_SARL - FIRST WRITTEN DECISION. Each founding member subscribes to the shares in the capitalization table annexed. The share capital has been deposited in a blocked escrow account at a licensed French bank or notary, in accordance with the provisions on formation. The registered office is established at the address stated in the articles, and the directors are authorized to execute the lease and register the company. Mrs/Mr. [name] is appointed as sole gérant, to serve for the statutory term, with full powers to represent the company, open bank accounts, and sign all formation documents. The gérant shall complete the legal publicity and RCS registration. All statutory formalities are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, authentication and signing of the statutory articles (statuts).
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company counsel / founding shareholders; notary optional unless a real property contribution is made.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify company name clearance at INPI. Draft the statuts in French containing the corporate form, duration (maximum 99 years), corporate object (design, manufacture, assembly, sale and after-sales service of high-speed aseptic beverage bottling and packaging lines), registered office address, share capital and division, payment schedule for contributions, powers of the gérant, and dispute settlement provisions. Ensure each shareholder signs the final version; a notarial instrument is required if a real estate contribution is included.
required_dossiers: Capitalization table and subscriber identity details
Registered office lease or ownership evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the statuts omit mandatory legal clauses, amend and re-sign before filing; no registry penalty arises if the omission is cured.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Blocked deposit of subscribed capital in a credit institution or notarial escrow.
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French licensed bank or notary authorized to hold funds; Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations in statutorily limited situations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional bank account in the name of the future SARL. Deposit at least one-fifth of each cash contribution, or the full amount required by the articles. Obtain a signed capital deposit certificate (attestation de dépôt de fonds) indicating the Company name, the account holder, the total amount, and the name of the bank or notary.
required_dossiers: Identity documents and KYC forms for each subscriber
Power of attorney if a representative signs
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or notary requests additional due diligence, supply the requested beneficial-owner and source-of-funds documentation within five working days; alternatively select another licensed institution while preserving the statutory wording of the deposit certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the formation notice in a legal announcements gazette (JAL).
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales in the département of the registered office, chosen from the official list maintained by the DILA.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Insert in the JAL a statutory notice containing the proposed corporate name and form, share capital, registered office, corporate object, legal duration, name of the gérant, and the RCS city where the Company will be registered. Submit the signed draft text through the JAL electronic or paper form. Obtain the original attestation de mise en insertion with the publication date and volume references.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of the publication fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL refuses publication because of missing mandatory mentions, republish a corrected notice and obtain a newly dated attestation. The original fee is not refundable if the mistake is attributable to the applicant.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic submission of the formation file to the INPI Guichet unique.
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI formalities portal (formalities.entreprises.gouv.fr), routing to the competent Greffe du tribunal de commerce.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online creation questionnaire with the Company name, registered office, legal form, share capital, corporate object, gérant details, and beneficial owners. Upload the signed statuts, capital deposit certificate, JAL attestation, registered office justification, declaration of beneficial owners, gérant acceptance, and supporting identities. Pay the statutory filing fee online. The portal issues a dated acknowledgement and transmits the file to the chosen greffe.
required_dossiers: Lease or occupancy agreement for the registered office
Copy of passports or identity cards of all shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the portal returns an incompleteness notice, complete the file within fifteen days using the same online procedure. If the greffe rejects the file as inadmissible, obtain a reasoned rejection, cure the defect, and resubmit. Unlawful rejection can be contested before the supervising commercial judge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS registration and issuance of the Kbis extract.
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce of the district of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the greffe verifies the legality of the file, the existence of statutory formalities, and the absence of name conflicts, the Company is entered in the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés. Legal personality begins on the date of RCS entry. The greffe issues the official corporate certificate (extrait Kbis) and the company receives its SIRET number.
required_dossiers: Complete formation file transferred from the Guichet unique
Proof of payment of registration fees and related taxes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the greffier issues observations, regularize the defect promptly within the allotted time. If the registration is formally refused, file a petition before the judge supervising the RCS (juge commis à la surveillance) or initiate the standard commercial-court procedure to obtain entry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration administrative activation: SIRET confirmation, social security employer registration, and sector formalities.
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INSEE (Sirene), URSSAF, DRIEETS, and the Chambers of Commerce as required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm in the Kbis the assignment of the SIRET number and the NAF/APE code 28.25Z corresponding to the manufacture of food-processing machinery. Register as employer with URSSAF if employees are to be hired. For international sales, ensure the EORI number and export licences, if any, are obtained. Notify DRIEETS of the opening of the industrial site for occupational health and safety jurisdiction.
required_dossiers: URSSAF employer registration declaration if hiring staff
Industrial property lease or site ownership deed
EORI application for customs and export operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SIRET number is not reflected in the Kbis or is delayed, submit a rectification request to INSEE. If URSSAF fails to recognise the employer status, forward the Kbis and a copy of the registration receipt. For customs matters, contact the local customs office or INPI portal to amend the EORI data.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Préfecture de département via DREAL (Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement), in conjunction with the fire and occupational safety authorities; legal regime under the French Environmental Code, Chapters I and II, Title I, Book V.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Déclaration or Enregistrement as an ICPE (Installation classée pour la protection de l'environnement) under Rubrique 2562 or applicable mechanical-manufacturing rubrics for the industrial site; specific product certification under the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC for the manufactured lines where applicable.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition écologique / DREAL - Inspection des installations classées
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Variable threshold regime: a typical mechanical manufacturing plant engaged in machining and assembly of beverage bottling lines is classified as ICPE Déclaration or Enregistrement under Rubrique 2562 depending on the floor area, installed power and chemical usage; a full EIA (étude d'impact) is required only when the activity exceeds the authorisation thresholds set in Articles R.122-2 and R.512-1 et seq. of the Environmental Code.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must meet the French environmental quality standards and any municipal sewer preauthorisation, with typical limits of COD 2,000 mg/L, BOD5 800 mg/L, and suspended solids 1,000 mg/L absent stricter local conditions. VOC emissions must comply with the IED Directive 2010/75/EU as transposed, including BAT conclusions and solvent management plans where solvent consumption exceeds 2 tonnes per year. Hazardous waste handling requires registered waste carriers, retention of waste codes, and disposal under the regulatory waste traceability system. Surface treatment discharges must meet the threshold values of the French Good Agricultural and Environmental Conditions? No — the standard limits under the ministerial order on machine-shop industrial wastewater apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the departmental fire and rescue services (SDIS) for the industrial premises, including means of escape, extinguishing systems, and first-response equipment. Independent structural load inspection by an approved Bureau de Contrôle for mezzanines, overhead rails and pressurised line components. Occupational clearance includes registration of the workplace health and safety regime with the inspection du travail, completion of the DUERP risk assessment, and compliance with CE marking and the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC for all machinery manufactured or deployed in the production line.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — portal: impots.gouv.fr; VAT registration via Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) in the relevant territorial department; European VIES data exchange for intra-community VAT numbers.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity conducting taxable operations in France must apply for a French SIREN/SIRET number and a TVA intracommunautaire identification number by filing the national registration form (form No. 14755 for non-resident taxable persons) with the DGFiP competent for non-resident taxpayers. If the foreign entity has no fixed establishment in France and is a non-EU resident, a French tax representative (fiscal representative) may be required to file VAT returns and pay VAT. The application must specify the precise nature of the supplies in France, expected turnover, business identification details from the home jurisdiction, and the appointed legal representative. Proof of the entity's existence, statutory registration, and director/manager identity must accompany the application. Upon completion, the DGFiP issues a French VAT identification number, which becomes the primary reference for customs, invoicing, electronic reporting, and refund claims.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; a French SARL is by default subject to corporate income tax (Impôt sur les Sociétés, IS) on its worldwide profits, with the territorial-scope exception for foreign permanent establishments. It is not treated as a pass-through entity unless an election is made under the specific statutory rules described below.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Under Article 206 of the Code Général des Impôts (CGI), a SARL is subject to IS by default. However, under Article 239 bis AA CGI, a SARL whose shares are held exclusively by individuals and whose manager is one of those individuals may elect to be taxed as an income-tax pass-through entity (régime des sociétés de personnes), losing IS status for an indefinite period. This election is irrevocable. Additionally, hybrid mismatch conversion elections under French anti-hybrid legislation (implementing ATAD) may apply to reclassify disregarded payments for French tax purposes; however, no US-style 'check-the-box' election exists in French domestic law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general EUR minimum threshold for a foreign entity making taxable supplies of goods or services in France; registration is obligatory from the first euro of turnover derived from a French taxable activity, unless an EU-wide distance-sales threshold of EUR 10,000 (for qualifying EU suppliers) or the domestic micro-business exemption in Article 293 B CGI (for French-established small businesses) applies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France is implementing a phased mandatory domestic B2B e-invoicing regime via the Portail Public de Facturation (PPF) or certified Plateformes de Dématérialisation Partenaires (PDP). Obligations apply progressively from 1 September 2026 for large enterprises and 1 September 2027 for SMEs/ETI, requiring structured electronic invoices, real-time transaction reporting to the tax administration through the PPF/PDP APIs, and digital archiving. No continuous transaction-control stamping of individual invoices exists as of the current stage; VAT returns remain periodic (CA3/CG/CA12). For in-store payments, fiscal cash-register software must meet NF 525 or equivalent certification requirements. Invoice data must include the TVA registration number, SIREN, and structured formats (Factur-X / UBL / CII) when transmitting through the mandated e-invoicing infrastructure.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods physically leaving the European Union are zero-rated (exonération) under Article 262-I-1° CGI, provided the seller retains unequivocal evidence of export within the statutory timeframe. Services linked to exported goods, including logistics, transport, and certain work on movable tangible property, may qualify for zero-rating when the supply is directly connected to the export transaction. Pure offshore services supplied to non-EC customers may be outside the scope of French VAT under the place-of-supply rules, provided the customer is established outside the EU and the services are not physically performed in France. All zero-rating claims must be supported by an export customs declaration (DAU/ENS) plus transport documentation showing the goods left the EU under the intended fiscal regime.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Validated customs export declaration (Electronic Summary Declaration / DAU) proving the EU exit date
Commercial invoice with explicit zero-rated export mention and French TVA intracommunautaire reference
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing cross-border carriage to a non-EU destination
Inward banking remittance certificate / SWIFT MT103 or equivalent proof of foreign payment received from the non-EU buyer
Incoterms-linked transport documentation (CMR, house/line man ship bills) confirming the contract of carriage
Any contract or order evidencing the commercial reality of the export transaction
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The French tax administration applies rigorous audit scrutiny to zero-rated export declarations, requiring the full documentation bundle to be produced during six-year or severely longer ordinary limitation periods (10 years for undisclosed operations). Any failure to substantiate the export results in immediate VAT reassessment at the standard 20% rate, plus interest (intérêts de retard), a 40% penalty for deliberate omission or inaccuracy under Articles 1729 or 1732 CGI, and up to 80% penalty for abusive fraud (manœuvre frauduleuse) under Article 1729-1 CGI. Criminal sanctions for export fraud or false customs declarations may include imprisonment and fines under the French Customs Code. Retrospective clawback is permitted for the entire period covered by the audit, together with joint and several liability of the tax representative if a foreign entity acted through a representative. Documentary evidence must demonstrate an actual physical export and a real commercial counterparty; fraudulent circular intra-EU or re-importation schemes expose the exporter to severe penalties and publication of sanctions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), acting concurrently with the Direction Generale du Tresor (French Treasury) and the Autorite de Controle Prudentiel et de Resolution (ACPR) for banking supervision and foreign-exchange statistical control.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a Eurozone jurisdiction with full current-account and capital-account convertibility under the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union and the French Monetary and Financial Code. No exchange control licence is required for ordinary commercial payments, capital injections, trade settlements or dividend remittances. Repatriation of profits is permitted, but dividends paid by a French SARL to non-French shareholders are subject to French withholding tax at 30% under domestic law unless the Parent Subsidiary Directive (2011/96/EU) or an applicable double-tax treaty reduces or eliminates the levy. The SARL must maintain a shareholder residence location certificate, board minutes approving the distribution and proof of effective beneficial ownership to secure treaty relief.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France does not impose mandatory surrender of export proceeds and sets no statutory conversion ratio. Export receipts may be credited to authorised foreign-currency accounts held with French credit institutions and converted at commercial market rates. For balance-of-payments statistical purposes, the collecting bank must file a declaration with Banque de France for every cross-border transaction with a value exceeding EUR 50,000. There is no repurchase obligation by the central bank, and no local currency delivery requirement exists for euro-denominated export receipts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account - Operational Current Account in EUR
Capital Escrow Account - Operational Current Account - Trade Finance Line

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Credit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank (Credit Agricole CIB)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account - Transaction Banking - Commercial Letter of Credit Issuance Facility
Capital Escrow Account - Operational Account - Import/Export Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility. France recognises Electronique Money Institutions (EMIs) authorised by the ACPR under PSD2, and a licensed offshore EMI passporting into France may hold safeguarding accounts and provide euro-denominated IBANs for operational payments, FX conversion and payment instruction processing. Legal constraints are that an EMI cannot grant credit, cannot accept deposits as a bank does, must keep e-money funds safeguarded in segregated accounts, and must apply the full French AML/CTF and KYC framework. For a non-European founder, an EMI can be used as a secondary payment rail, but it cannot replace a tier-1 French bank for capital escrow, documentary credits or treasury hedging.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and ultimate beneficial owners are not statutorily obliged to appear physically in France for account opening, as French AML regulation permits remote identity verification by secure video conference with digital identity attestation. In practice, however, tier-1 French banks will require an interview with the managing director and each material UBO, either in person at a French branch or via videoconference supported by apostilled corporate documents and certified passport copies. A one-week physical visit to Paris or Lyon is the safest pathway for the non-resident shareholder to open the capital escrow account and establish the trade finance relationship.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO holding a passport from a high-risk or FATF-grey-listed jurisdiction, with first capital contribution originating from a third-country private individual.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled constitutional documents of the SARL; full shareholder chain of title; certified passports and proof of residential address; three years of personal tax returns or audited financial statements; independent legal opinion from a French avocat verifying the beneficial owner; three months of originating bank statements; written affidavit of source of funds and wealth genesis.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital contribution exceeding EUR 150,000 within 90 days of incorporation without a matching commercial order book or payroll substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan for the high-speed aseptic beverage bottling line scope (ISIC 2825); signed letter of intent or preliminary purchase contract from the end customer; technical after-sales service staffing plan; projected treasury and cash-flow model; evidence of the intended use of the escrowed capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Overlay of an intermediary trader in a non-EU jurisdiction for outbound payments and commission structures, creating split-payment or circular-flow risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master equipment purchase agreement covering manufacturing, testing, installation and validation; commercial invoices referencing the relevant HS code for aseptic packaging machinery; packing list and full Incoterms 2020 routing; original bill of lading or airway bill; Intrastat or customs declaration; direct SWIFT GPI payment audit trail proving the physical movement of the bottling line.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Recurrent shareholder current-account advances exceeding share capital and creating an informal loan structure without commercial terms.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised shareholder loan agreements with arm's length interest rates; intercompany transfer-pricing documentation; annual reconciliation of the current-account ledger; statutory auditor (Commissaire aux Comptes) report if the SARL exceeds legal size thresholds; Board resolution formalising the liquidity structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: First documentary credit or trade settlement presented with L/C amendments, mixed funding sources and routing through a so-called quick-turnaround bank.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full underlying supply contract with acceptance milestones; signed technical specification and line-performance guarantees; audit-proof Commissioning certificate; bank-to-bank correspondence records (SWIFT MT199/MT999); transaction dossier with customs valuations and invoice substantiation; corporate treasury policy limiting the use of unusual correspondent corridors.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound capital injections from the non-resident shareholder must be routed by SWIFT MT103 (or SEPA credit transfer for EU shareholders) to the SARL's French IBAN. The remittance instruction must indicate the full SARL legal name and SIREN number, the character of the fund as
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.(capital contribution) or: (shareholder loan), and the purpose narrative 'Aseptic beverage packaging automated line'. For amounts exceeding EUR 50,000, the bank must complete the declaration to Banque de France. Prior Ministry of Economy authorisation under the French foreign-investment screening regime is not required for ISIC 2825 manufacturing, unless activities touch critical technologies, data collection, dual-use or national defence, but a non-EU investor should keep a legal memo confirming that the non-sensitive nature of the bottling-line business is assessed against Annex I of Decree 2019-1590.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for imported components and subcontracting services will be executed through SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for advance payments, balances and spare parts, and through irrevocable documentary letters of credit issued under UCP600 (SWIFT MT700, with MT707 amendments where required) for the full invoice value of high-speed aseptic filling lines. Intra-SEPA euro payments can clear via SEPA Instant Credit Transfer or SEPA Credit Transfer through the Eurosystem infrastructure; non-EEA payouts require correspondent banking with a clear network of the paying bank. The SARL should instruct all L/Cs as 'available with the issuing bank', require original transport documents, and subject to Incoterms 2020, with bank charges segmented as OUR/BEN/SHA to avoid double billing. The treasury centre will monitor clearing timelines using SWIFT GPI and confirm all disbursement instructions include the SARL tax number and invoice reference.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD and EUR/XXX plain vanilla currency forwards with an ACPR-licensed credit institution under an ISDA master agreement or FEEMA confirmation
Foreign-exchange swaps (swap de change) for the temporary conversion of equity injection and trade settlement balances
Purchased European-style currency options to protect the SARL against unfavourable dollar or Asian-currency movements while retaining upside

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for currencies with restricted onshore convertibility (e.g., emerging-market Asian currencies) where delivery in base currency is permitted by the French counterparty bank
Cross-currency basis swaps matched against the SARL's long-term borrowing or financing structure, if approved by the Board and supported by a real underlying commercial exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts deposit and publication (dépôt des comptes annuels): balance sheet, profit-and-loss statement, annexes and, where applicable, statutory auditor's report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS) of the competent commercial court, filed electronically through the INPI Guichet Unique single filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one (1) month of the shareholders' meeting approving the accounts and in no event later than seven (7) months after the fiscal year end (L. 232-23, R. 232-20 C. com.). For a 31 December year end: approval by 30 June, RCS filing by 31 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The registry serves a formal notice (injonction); continuing default is transmitted to the public prosecutor and may result in a court order to file under astreinte; repeated non-filing can lead to judicial strike-off from the RCS, loss of legal personality and compulsory liquidation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and tax package (liasse fiscale): forms 2065-SD and 2050 to 2059-A-SD, including result declaration, balance sheet annexes and reduced tax credits statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — the Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) competent for the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Second working day following 1 May for a fiscal year closing on 31 December (CGI art. 223-1); for any other closing date, within three (3) months after the fiscal year end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% of the corporate income tax assessed; 40% if filed after a 30-day formal notice; 80% in case of fraudulent concealment; plus late-payment interest of 0.20% per month and minimum fine of EUR 150 (CGI art. 1728, 1731). Prolonged default triggers automatic tax assessment and criminal sanctions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of the beneficial owner declaration (confirmation annuelle de la déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: INPI Guichet Unique, incorporated into the company's RCS registry file (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneous with the annual accounts filing — within one (1) month of the shareholders' meeting approval and in any case within seven (7) months of the fiscal year end (Art. R. 561-32-1 Code monétaire et financier).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to confirm annually or submission of an incomplete or inaccurate declaration is punishable by up to six (6) months' imprisonment and EUR 7,500 fine; continued default may be reported by the registry and may block lawful corporate secretarial renewals.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval of the annual accounts at the shareholders' annual meeting (AGO), recording of minutes, profit allocation or carried-loss position, and optional dividend distribution authorization
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: No external filing; the minutes are entered in the register of shareholders' decisions (registre des décisions d'associés) at the registered office, and the approved accounts support the subsequent RCS annual deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six (6) months of the fiscal year end (L. 223-29 Code de commerce); any shareholder may petition the court to convene the meeting if the deadline is exceeded.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The manager who deliberately fails to establish true annual accounts or records false decisions is subject to criminal penalties of up to five (5) years' imprisonment and EUR 375,000 fine (L. 242-6-1 C. com.); civil liability and judicial strike-off may also result from accumulated default.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) for a SARL where the share capital exceeds EUR 1,000,000, or where, at the balance-sheet date, the company exceeds two of three thresholds: total balance sheet EUR 4,000,000, net turnover excluding VAT EUR 8,000,000, average number of employees 50 (L. 223-35, R. 223-4 C. com.). Group-level appointment also applies where the entity exceeds the group thresholds of EUR 50,000,000 consolidated balance sheet or turnover and 500 average employees, or controls more than 10 companies (L. 823-2-2 C. com.).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général) per ANC Règlement n° 2014-03, as amended; IFRS applies only to consolidated financial statements of listed parents or where French consolidation law mandates it; the standalone SARL files annual accounts under French local GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Pursuant to Article R. 561-32-1 of the Code monétaire et financier, the beneficial owner declaration filed at registration must be re-confirmed every year at the time the annual accounts are filed: if no change exists, a negative confirmation statement is submitted via the Guichet Unique; any change during the year requires a separate updated declaration within 30 days of the change; the declaration covers any natural person holding at least 25% of the share capital or voting rights or exercising control in law or in fact.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registre des décisions d'associés (shareholders' decisions and minutes book, including approval of annual accounts and profit allocation)
Registre des conventions réglementées (statutory register of related-party agreements subject to special approval procedures)
Registre des mouvements de titres de capital (share transfer and pledge register recording all SARL quota transfers)
Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (beneficial ownership register maintained in the statutory corporate file at the registered office)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 - USD 1,300 per year (typical commercial domiciliation services in business centres, excluding incorporation and secretarial add-ons)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,500 - USD 25,000 per engagement (typical certified audit fee for a mid-sized manufacturing SARL with annexed schedules)

stage_6.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide French tax representative contact if non-resident manager; keep EORI/legal existence proof.
